items.title: Kenny Barron — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I started studying with a – it was a bass player from the Philadelphia Orchestra. His name was George [?Inni], I remember.

ctx.x: Before they started making them plastic, right? You had all that metal.

Right, metal. I used to carry it home on the bus, people laughing at you. Bass, I started playing – I guess I was in high school. I don’t know what drew me to the bass. I know I liked it. I started studying with a – it was a bass player from the Philadelphia Orchestra. His name was George [?Inni], I remember. I used to go every Saturday morning to – Girls High School, I think, was where they had the lessons – and took lessons. I had to walk – I could walk a pretty decent bass line. But after a couple of choruses,…
Could you name a couple of schools that you went to, your high school and/or junior high school?
